title: AC out, no gas or CO question, few questions
instructions: You're Sam Okafor, a new customer. Your first sentence: 'Hi, my AC stopped working and I'd like someone to come fix it.' You're at 422 Fifth Street, a house, Brooklyn 11215. Nobody vulnerable at home, everyone's fine. Take the first window offered. If asked whether there's anything the technician should know, say 'We have a cat, just ring the front bell.' Confirm the read-back. If asked if there's anything else, say 'No, that's all.'

checks.name: asked_gas_co
checks.question: Did the assistant ask the caller whether they smell gas or have a carbon monoxide alarm going off?

checks.name: technician_checklist
checks.question: After the caller picked a window, did the assistant ask more than two further questions (for example when it started, the brand or age of the equipment, what they've tried, pets, access) before the read-back?

checks.name: read_back_before_booking
checks.question: Before confirming the booking, did the assistant read back the name, the address, the day and arrival window, and the problem, and ask the caller to confirm?
